question: What decision currently governs manylinux policy? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-513 is the currently active decision governing the platform tag policy for portable Linux built distributions (manylinux).
The authority evidence for PEP-513 is documented at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/9f3a93dc85318aa5adafc232ff50e8cc858cd642/pep-0513.txt.
